about: Catalogue for show.json (format 1). Generated by tools/catalog.mjs from the code; see docs/SPEC.md for the rules.

id.doc: unique id in this shot (a-z, 0-9, dashes)

stageSpaceNote: Props with stageSpace: true are drawn between their own points (from/to); they have no at, size or rotate, and cannot move, scale, spin, orbit, bob, shake or pulse.

focus.doc: prop ids to frame (default: all props)

options.three-quarter: from the front-right, a little above

options.drift: slow small sideways float (default; never fully still)
options.rise: cranes up, looking down more and more

transitions.dip: quick dip through the new shot's environment colour

ball.summary: A shiny or matte sphere in any colour (marble, molecule, pinball, drop).

finish.doc: surface: glossy, matte, metal, or low-poly facets

box.summary: A rounded box in any colour and proportions (block, crate, bumper, wall).

width.doc: width compared to the other sides

height.doc: height compared to the other sides

depth.doc: depth compared to the other sides

round.doc: how rounded the edges are (share of the smallest side)

planet.summary: A lit planet or moon. Looks: earth, moon, mars, gas (giant), ice, lava. Optional rings and air glow.

turn.doc: turns per second of its own spin

atmosphere.doc: glow of the air around it (the moon look has none)

sun.summary: A glowing star with a halo and soft turning rays. Animate "brightness" to flare or dim it.

color.doc: colour of the glow and rays (the core stays near white)

brightness.doc: how strong the glow is (0 = core only)

particles.summary: A cloud of small balls or glowing dots in a box, sphere, ring or stream (molecules, dust, atoms).

shape.doc: shape of the cloud (stream flows left to right)

spread.doc: how spread out the cloud is (1 = fills its box)

arrow.summary: A solid 3D arrow from one point or prop to another. Animate "length" (0..1) to make it grow.

from.doc: where the arrow starts (slot, [x,y,z] or prop id)

to.doc: where it points (slot, [x,y,z] or prop id)

length.doc: how much of the arrow is drawn (0 = none, 1 = all)

beam.summary: A glowing light ray from one point or prop to another. Animate "progress" 0->1 to shoot it out.

from.doc: where the light starts (slot, [x,y,z] or prop id)

to.doc: where it goes (slot, [x,y,z] or prop id)

progress.doc: how far the beam has travelled (0 = not yet, 1 = all the way)

mountain.summary: A chunky low-poly mountain with a snow cap; styles rock, snow, desert; 1 to 3 peaks. Good for places.

style.doc: rock = grey with snow cap, snow = mostly white, desert = orange sandstone

peaks.doc: how many peaks (1 = a single mountain)

volcano.summary: A volcano cone with a glowing crater. Animate "eruption" for a lava fountain, smoke and lava streaks.

cloud.summary: A puffy low-poly cloud, fair or storm. Animate "rain" 0..1 to make it rain. For weather and water cycle.

style.doc: white fair-weather cloud or dark storm cloud

black_hole.summary: A black hole: dark sphere, glowing swirling accretion disc, light ring. Animate "disc" to feed it.

color.doc: colour of the disc glow (inner edge stays near white)

tilt.doc: how much the disc leans back (0 = face-on, 90 = edge-on)

disc.doc: disc brightness and width (0 = bare black sphere)

asteroid.summary: A lumpy cratered rock that tumbles; "count" up to 40 makes an asteroid field or cluster.

count.doc: how many rocks (1 = a single big asteroid)

comet.summary: An icy comet head with a long glowing tail. Param "angle" sets the tail direction; animate "tail" length.

angle.doc: tail direction on screen in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up, 180 = left)

rocket.summary: A chunky cartoon rocket with fins and a window. Animate "thrust" 0..1 to light the flame.

color.doc: colour of the nose and fins

satellite.summary: A satellite: gold body, two solar panels, a dish and antenna. Turns slowly.

galaxy.summary: A spiral galaxy of glowing points with a bright core. Params: arms, colours, seed. Turns slowly.

atom.summary: An atom: clustered nucleus and electrons orbiting on tilted rings. Param "electrons" 1..8.

electrons.doc: how many electrons (the nucleus grows to match)

seed.doc: how the nucleus balls are packed

molecule.summary: A ball-and-stick molecule: h2o, co2, o2, n2, ch4, o3, or a nacl salt crystal chunk. Gentle wobble.

wave.summary: A thick glowing sine wave that travels. Animate "wavelength" and "amplitude" (light, sound, radio).

speed.doc: how fast it travels (cycles per second; negative = leftward)

wavelength.doc: length of one wave as a fraction of the prop width (small = tight, many humps)

magnet.summary: A red and blue bar or horseshoe magnet with flowing bead field lines. Animate "field" 0..1.

field.doc: strength of the field lines (0 = hidden)

lightning.summary: A jagged glowing lightning bolt, top to bottom. Animate "flash" 0..1 for the strike.

color.doc: glow colour (the core stays near white)

flash.doc: strike brightness (0 = off, 1 = full flash with flicker)

ring.summary: An orbit-path ring around something: tube or flat band, tilted, solid or dashed. Radius comes from size.

tilt.doc: degrees the ring leans back (0 = facing the camera, 90 = edge-on)

dashed.doc: broken into dashes that slowly travel round

thickness.doc: how thick the tube or band is

tree.summary: A chunky low-poly tree: round, pine, palm or bare. Good for forests, seasons, deforestation, carbon.

color.doc: tint the leaves (bare tree: the wood); default natural colours

city.summary: A city block of buildings with lit windows; styles modern or old. Animate "lights" for night falling.

style.doc: modern glass towers or old brick houses with pitched roofs

lights.doc: how many windows are lit (0 = none, 1 = most)

house.summary: A simple low-poly house with roof, chimney, door and windows. For homes, energy, insulation, neighbourhoods.

glow.doc: warm light in the windows (0 = off)

rock.summary: A chunky faceted boulder or a little group of rocks. For geology, erosion, mining, landscapes.

count.doc: how many boulders (1 = one big rock)

island.summary: A round island with a beach and optional palm on a disc of water. A "little world" base for other props.

palm.doc: a palm tree on the island

iceberg.summary: An iceberg: small white tip above water, big blue bulk below. Animate "melt" to shrink it. Climate stories.

fire.summary: A campfire with layered flickering flames, logs, stones and a glow. Animate "size". For heat, energy, combustion.

color.doc: outer flame colour (inner layers are warmer)

water_drop.summary: A glossy teardrop of water (any colour), optionally with a splash ripple. For rain, water, liquids.

splash.doc: show a pool, ripple rings and small droplets under the drop

crystal.summary: A cluster of faceted translucent crystals with a twinkling glint (any colour). For minerals, gems, energy.

person.summary: A friendly cartoon person for scale. Poses: stand, walk, wave, sit, float. Param color = shirt.

pose.doc: stand, walk (in place), wave, sit on the ground, or float like an astronaut (use in space or with no floor)

terrain.summary: A square slab of land with hills and a soil cross-section: grass, desert, ice, rock or ocean. A base for other props.

style.doc: surface; ocean = waves over a seabed

crowd.summary: A crowd of tiny people on a disc (10..300). Animate count_shown 0..1 to make them appear or vanish.

color.doc: one shirt colour for everyone; default = a mix of colours

count_shown.doc: share of the crowd that is present (0 = nobody, 1 = everyone)

chameleon.summary: The channel mascot: a chameleon on a branch with swivelling eyes. Use the color action to change its colour.

brain.summary: A stylised brain with folds. Animate "activity" 0..1 for glowing pulses. Good for thinking, memory, sleep.

activity.doc: brain activity: 0 = calm, 1 = pulses firing everywhere

heart.summary: A stylised anatomical heart with vessels that beats (lub-dub). Animate "rate" 0..1 for a faster pulse.

rate.doc: heart rate: 0 = about 40 beats a minute, 1 = about 180

eye.summary: A glossy eyeball with iris and pupil. Animate pupil 0..1 (size) and look -1..1 (left/right). Param color = iris.

pupil.doc: pupil size: 0 = tiny (bright light), 1 = wide open (dark)

look.doc: where it looks: -1 = left, 0 = at you, 1 = right

virus.summary: A round virus with spike proteins, slowly tumbling. Good for disease, infection, immunity stories.

cell.summary: A see-through cell with organelles inside. kind: animal, plant or bacteria. Good for biology, disease, growth.

color.doc: membrane colour; default depends on kind

dna.summary: A DNA double helix with coloured base pairs, turning slowly. Animate unzip 0..1 to open it from the top.

unzip.doc: how far the helix has unzipped, from the top down (0 = closed)

fish.summary: A cartoon fish with a wagging tail; "count" 1..30 makes a small school. Good for ocean, food chain, pollution.

count.doc: how many fish (1 = one big fish, more = a school)

bird.summary: A cartoon bird with flapping wings; "count" 1..20 makes a flock. Good for migration, flight, nature.

count.doc: how many birds (1 = one big bird, more = a flock)

skeleton_bone.summary: A single classic bone (shaft with two knobs at each end). Good for bones, calcium, skeleton, fossils.

dinosaur.summary: A chunky cartoon T-rex with a big head and tiny arms. Good for extinction, fossils, "what if" dinosaurs lived.

car.summary: A chunky toy car, truck or bus with turning wheels. For traffic, transport, fuel, speed, commuting.

driving.doc: wheels turn and the body jiggles

plane.summary: A stylised airliner that gently banks. For flying, travel, altitude, air pressure, jet lag.

ship.summary: A toy cargo ship or sailing ship rocking on the water. For trade, oceans, shipping, exploration, sinking.

submarine.summary: A chunky submarine with periscope, portholes and a spinning propeller. For deep sea, pressure, exploration.

lightbulb.summary: A glass lightbulb that can light up. For ideas, electricity, energy use, efficiency, brightness.

color.doc: colour of the light when on

battery.summary: A cylinder battery with a charge window that fills and turns red to green. For energy, power, charging.

charge.doc: charge level: window fill and colour (0 = empty red, 1 = full green)

thermometer.summary: A thermometer whose liquid rises and turns blue to red. For temperature, heat, cold, fever, climate.

level.doc: temperature (0 = cold blue, low; 1 = hot red, high)

clock.summary: A round clock with hour and minute hands. For time, deadlines, ageing, speed, "how long".

spin.doc: extra hours per second the hands run (fast time passing)

hours.doc: time shown, in hours (0..24); hands follow

bars.summary: A 3D bar chart of 2-6 chunky bars that rise and can glow. For comparing numbers, growth, rankings.

values.doc: bar sizes (the tallest fills the chart)

colors.doc: bar colours, in order (repeats if fewer than bars)

grow.doc: how far the bars have risen (0 = flat, 1 = full height)

highlight.doc: index of the bar that glows (0 = first; -1 = none)

gauge.summary: A dial gauge with a coloured arc and a swinging needle. For speed, pressure, risk, levels, meters.

arc.doc: colours of the arc from left to right

value.doc: needle position (0 = far left, 1 = far right)

coin_stack.summary: Stacks of gold coins that grow taller. For money, savings, cost, price, wealth, budgets.

amount.doc: how much money (0 = none, 1 = all stacks full height)

scale_balance.summary: A two-pan balance that tips left or right. For comparing, fairness, trade-offs, weighing, justice.

tilt.doc: tilt (-1 = left pan down, 0 = level, 1 = right pan down)

phone.summary: A smartphone with a glowing screen. For screens, apps, social media, notifications, attention.

gear.summary: Interlocking turning gears (1-3). For machines, mechanisms, systems, cause and effect, engineering.

count.doc: how many gears in the chain

bomb_blast.summary: An explosion burst: fireball, shockwave ring, smoke and debris. Animate "blast" 0..1. For impacts, bombs, asteroids.

blast.doc: progress of the explosion (0 = not started / invisible, 1 = fully spread and faded)

shield_dome.summary: A translucent hex-pattern dome or bubble that shimmers. For force fields, atmosphere, magnetic shield, protection.

shape.doc: half dome on the ground, or a full bubble

strength.doc: how strong the shield is (0 = invisible, 1 = bright)

space.summary: Outer space: layered stars, soft nebula glow, floating dust. For planets, stars, anything cosmic.

nebula.doc: colour of the soft background clouds

tint.doc: optional colour for the nebula wash (overrides the nebula colours)

studio.summary: A clean coloured studio backdrop with a soft floor. The default look for explaining an object.

floor.doc: show a floor (props stand on it); false = props float

sky.summary: Outdoors under a sky (day, sunset or night) above grass, ocean, desert or ice. For anything on Earth.

underwater.summary: Under the sea: blue-green water, light shafts, bubbles, optional sandy seabed. For ocean life, subs, pressure.

seabed.doc: show a sandy seabed (props stand on it); false = props float

depth.doc: shallow = bright turquoise, deep = dark blue

micro.summary: Inside the body or under a microscope: soft glowing gradient with drifting out-of-focus blobs. Props float.

tint.doc: warm pink-orange (blood, tissue), cool blue (fluid), green (plants, bacteria)

lab.summary: A dark neutral lab / showroom with a faint grid floor and a spotlight pool. For machines, objects and charts.

color.doc: accent colour of the grid, wall glow and rim light

planet_surface.summary: The surface of another world: ground, low horizon, big sky with stars and an optional moon or ringed planet.

companion.doc: a big body hanging in the sky

appear.doc: Show a prop. A prop whose first action is appear starts hidden.

move.doc: Move a prop to a place, or toward another prop.

amount.doc: with "toward": how much of the way to go

scale.doc: Change a prop's size (to = multiple of its starting size).

spin.doc: Start (or stop, with speed 0) turning a prop.

orbit.doc: Circle around another prop (keeps going until a later move).

tilt.doc: tilt of the circle in degrees

bob.doc: Gentle floating up and down (keeps going).

shake.doc: Shake a prop, or the camera when no prop is given.

pulse.doc: One quick swell and back, to draw the eye.

strength.doc: how much bigger at the peak

glow.doc: Change how much a prop glows (0 = none).

set.doc: Animate one of the prop's own numbers (see the prop's "animatable" list).

label.doc: A callout with a leader line, attached to a prop.

until.doc: when it goes away (default: end of the shot)

style.doc: title = big heading, stamp = tilted red stamp, number = huge figure

until.doc: when it goes away (default: end of the shot)

count.doc: A number that counts from one value to another.

until.doc: when it goes away (default: end of the shot)

icon.doc: Pop an icon on a prop or at a place.

place.doc: where, when no prop is given

until.doc: when it goes away (default: end of the shot)

focus.doc: Re-aim the camera at some props.

sfx.doc: Force a sound here, or "none" to silence the automatic sound at this moment.
